additional_facts.label: French press recipe
additional_facts.context: French press; site brewcard shown on currentpage.

evidence.quote: For French PressMeasure 35g (7 tbsp) coffee, coarse (like breadcrumbs).Add coffee and 520g (2 cups) hot water (200°F) to press. Stir gently.Steep for 4 min, then press plunger down slowly.

additional_facts.label: Espresso recipe
additional_facts.context: Espresso; no temperature explicitlyinthiscard.

evidence.quote: For EspressoMeasure 18-20g of finely ground coffee (like powdered sugar).Tamp grounds firmly into portafilter.Lock portafilter into machine, start extraction.Aim for 25-30 secs for about 30g espresso.

additional_facts.label: AeroPress recipe
additional_facts.context: AeroPress;10secis stirnot total.

evidence.quote: For An AeroPressMeasure 15-17g (2-3 tbsp) coffee, medium-fine (like table salt).Insert rinsed paper filter into cap, attach to AeroPress, and add grounds.Add 200g (¾ cup) hot water (175°F/80°C), stir for 10 sec.

additional_facts.label: Drip recipe
additional_facts.context: Drip

evidence.quote: For Drip CoffeeMeasure 50-55g (10 tbsp) of medium ground coffee (like sand).Add grounds to a filter in the chamber.Fill the reservoir with enough water.

additional_facts.label: Chemex/pourover recipe
additional_facts.context: Chemex/pour-over;30secisbloom nottotal.

evidence.quote: For Chemex or Pour OverMeasure 25-30g (3-4 tbsp) coffee, medium-coarse (like sea salt).Rinse filter with hot water, discard rinse water, and add grounds.Pour 60g hot water (200°F/93°C) to bloom for 30 seconds.Slowly pour water in circles to 450g total.
